new_packages.label_en: The Children of Moses and Transcendent Souls
new_packages.reason: The entire teaching of Torah #273 is a single bechina equation: the category of 'elevated children' (בְּנֵי עֲלִיָּה) who beget transcendent souls IS, in essential nature, the bechina of the children of Moses (וְזֶה בְּחִינוֹת בְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה). The quality that binds these concepts together is 'transcendence of the sixty-myriads framework' — the state of being 'above sixty myriads,' not countable from this world at all. The children of Rechabiah serve as the scriptural exemplar of this same essential nature. These are not cause-effect relationships; they are all expressions of the same archetype: souls and their progenitors who stand outside the normal framework of embodied existence.
new_packages.source_bechina_statement: וְזֶה בְּחִינוֹת בְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה — 'And this is the aspect/bechina of the children of Moses'

observations:
Torah #273 presents an unusual case: the entire Torah is a single, tightly unified bechina statement. There is no multi-package structure to identify because the Torah does not develop multiple thematic domains. It makes one claim — that a category of transcendent souls and their progenitors (בְּנֵי עֲלִיָּה) are the bechina of the children of Moses — and supports it with one proof-text (Rechabiah's children = above sixty myriads).

The reason a NEW_PACKAGES_PROPOSED verdict is issued rather than NO_NEW_PACKAGES is that the dataset has zero bechina edges for Torah #273, meaning this Torah is completely unrepresented. The source text contains explicit bechina language ('וְזֶה בְּחִינוֹת בְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה') connecting three or more concepts into one independent conceptual domain that is not a sub-cluster of any existing package in a larger Torah — it is the complete and entire content of this Torah.

The proposed package has a single polarity (good) and no evil mirror. The teaching does not discuss an opposing force; it is purely a positive ontological statement about a category of transcendent souls. This is consistent with many of the shorter Torahs in LM1 that make a single definitional point without developing the good/evil mirror structure.

The dominant node is בְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה because it is the named archetype that the Rebbe identifies as the reference point ('וְזֶה בְּחִינוֹת בְּנֵי מֹשֶׁה') — it is the concept whose essential nature defines the entire cluster. The three proposed bechina edges capture the complete conceptual content of this Torah and should be added to torahData.js to give Torah #273 meaningful representation in the map.
